title: Grateful Dead Live at Bellarmine College on 1968-12-07
source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD D

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a rare 1968 Louisville show with a smoking Dark Star > St. Stephen > Eleven and the only known live Rosemary, audio is decent but shows noticeable hiss.
ai_review.review: The performance shines with an extended Dark Star > St. Stephen > Eleven suite, a powerful Death Don't Hurt Me, New Potato Caboose, and the unique, quiet rendition of Rosemary that makes this show special. The soundboard source has been cleaned up, yet some hiss and occasional roughness remain, giving it a solid but not pristine listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical moments (especially Dark Star suite and Rosemary) while noting only modest recording flaws; weighted average yields a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hiss present despite cleanup by Charlie, occasional roughness and incomplete song sections, but overall clear enough for a 1968 tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong early set leading into a monster second set; seamless transitions in the Dark Star suite and a memorable, quiet Rosemary that adds rarity value.
